description: KugelAudio GmbH is a Berlin, Germany voice-AI company that builds and hosts its models in Europe. It sells a multilingual text-to-speech API (Kugel 3 family, 39 languages, zero-shot voice cloning), Kugel Ear speech-to-text for nine European languages, the Kugel Fluid speech-to-speech voice-agent model (beta) and Clarity speech enhancement.
name: KugelAudio
